propositions: S3-mode detection via remote URL scheme (s3:// or s3+zip://) requires git-remote-s3 helper >= 0.3.2 to prevent multiple-bundles corruption from missing IfNoneMatch per-ref lock
A new _require_s3_helper_if_s3_url() preflight guard must raise OptionalDependencyError unconditionally (bypassing best-effort mode) when an s3:// remote is configured without the required helper

The S3 preflight must be called at three points: synchronous push path after URL resolution at push.py:418, async push arm before child detach, and init/mount in _mount_or_create_branch after remote name resolution

OptionalDependencyError from S3 preflight must propagate uncaught through write_and_push and be re-raised in push_after_commit exception handler to abort corrupting operations while preserving local commit durability
No new config schema keys, remote URL resolution seams, or helper functions in gitutil.py are added; reuse existing _git remote get-url calls
Non-s3:// remotes, unresolvable remotes, and async=off mode are unaffected; the guard is a pure no-op for non-S3 schemes
